title: v6.1.0 on Jordan's Macs reads the production feed
done_when: on each of Jordan's Macs the installed app's SUFeedURL is appcast.xml (not appcast-test.xml) and Sparkle's last check in Tether.log reached it without an error
command: plutil -extract SUFeedURL raw ~/Applications/Tether.app/Contents/Info.plist && grep -i sparkle ~/Library/Logs/Tether.log | tail -5
